info.title: Corral Dashboard API
info.description: The host-side control plane for Corral: repos, projects, GitHub issues, and the automations engine (actions, hooks, flows, runs, prompts) plus the host-wide logs and trace tree. The dashboard UI is one client; the `corral api` CLI and the host Claude skill are others. Loopback-only and token-gated. Mutating calls (POST/PUT/DELETE) require the operator to enable API writes in global settings; reads are always allowed.

get.description: The activity field is how you tell whether a project's Claude is actively working ('working') or idle at the prompt waiting on the user ('waiting'), or the container is down ('off'). It's computed from real completion activity (POST /v1/messages when the traffic is decrypted, else a proxy.log heuristic).

post.summary: Connect a remote MCP server
post.description: Runs `claude mcp add --scope user`. A mutating call — when made by the CLI/host Claude it requires API writes to be enabled; the browser is never gated.

delete.description: Runs `claude mcp remove <name>`. Mutating — gated for the CLI/Claude, never for the browser.

post.summary: Start the interactive OAuth login for an MCP server
post.description: Runs `claude mcp login <name>` in a bridged terminal (the browser attaches over a WebSocket). Use this for a server whose status is needs_auth. Mutating — gated for the CLI/Claude; in practice the user completes the browser OAuth.

get.summary: Get a flow's pseudo-cron schedule

put.description: cadenceSeconds is the interval; catchUp fires once on wake when overdue (else the miss is skipped); enabled pauses it. Mutating — gated for CLI/Claude, not the browser. The tick that FIRES a scheduled flow is never gated.

get.description: configured=false means the user hasn't chosen yet → the dashboard shows a first-run prompt. Governs the app-wide chat dock only.

put.description: readonly = look only; act = can run corral api (still fenced by the API-writes gate). A browser preference, not itself gated.

get.description: Counts local Corral DB PR records whose fetched_at is older than olderThanDays, without deleting. LOCAL ONLY — never touches GitHub.

post.summary: Prune old local PR records (local DB cleanup, not GitHub)
post.description: Deletes local Corral DB PR records whose fetched_at is older than olderThanDays (default 30; floor 1), cascading to their blocks/links/chat. LOCAL ONLY — it does not close or delete anything on GitHub. Optional repo scopes it.

get.summary: List a PR's local notes
get.description: Private, LOCAL notes on a PR — stored only in Corral's DB, never posted to GitHub (unlike a PR comment). Newest first.

post.summary: Add a local note to a PR
post.description: Adds a private, local note (never sent to GitHub). Body required; author is an optional free-text label.

post.summary: Merge a PR (host | plain)
post.description: Merges a PR. mode "plain" does a direct `gh pr merge` (fails if not mergeable). mode "host" starts a detached host-merge background job (rebase onto base, resolve conflicts, wait for CI, merge) and returns its jobId — watch it in the Work tab; NOT sandboxed. If no merge strategy is set for the repo or globally (and none is passed), returns 400 telling you to set a per-repo default first. mode defaults to the global default mode.

400.description: No strategy set / invalid mode or strategy

get.summary: Get a repo's merge-strategy state
get.description: Returns the merge methods GitHub allows for the repo, the per-repo preference, the global default, and the resolved effective strategy.

put.summary: Set a repo's PREFERRED merge strategy
put.description: Sets the per-repo merge strategy preference (the preferred place to record a choice — repo beats global). Empty string clears it. This is what to call when a merge errored because no strategy was set.

post.summary: Start AI analysis (enrich) on a PR — fire and return
post.description: Kicks off the per-block AI analysis (title/explanation/edge-cases/risk + a PR summary) via host Claude, in the BACKGROUND, and returns immediately. Poll GET /api/prs/{id}/analysis for completion, then read GET /api/prs/{id}/blocks. Idempotent while running.

post.summary: Start the PR-level risk verdict — fire and return
post.description: Kicks off the PR risk assessment via host Claude in the BACKGROUND; returns immediately. Poll GET /api/prs/{id}/analysis, then read GET /api/prs/{id}/risk.

get.summary: Poll AI analysis job status (enrich + risk)
get.description: Returns the background-job state for both the enrich and risk analyses of a PR, so a caller knows when a fired analysis has finished.

get.summary: Read a PR's analyzed blocks
get.description: The hotness-ranked code blocks for a PR, including any AI enrichment. Read after enrich finishes.

get.summary: Read a PR's stored risk verdict
get.description: The last computed risk assessment (null if never analyzed). Read after analyze finishes.

post.summary: Run repo forensics (git history hotness) — not AI
post.description: Computes per-file git-history signals (churn, fix ratio, staleness) used to rank PR blocks. Synchronous; git-only, no LLM. Poll/read GET /api/repos/{id}/analysis-status.

get.summary: Whether a repo's forensics analysis is present/fresh

post.summary: Spawn a worker Claude (conductor delegation)
post.description: Starts a fresh, INDEPENDENT worker Claude (not a subagent) as a detached background job that runs the given prompt on the host in a neutral dir, with the global chat's tool capability. Returns its job id; watch/steer/close it in the dashboard Work tab or via the /merge-jobs endpoints (workers are jobs). Use this to delegate tasks instead of doing everything in one conductor session.

get.summary: List captured Claude conversations (keyset, filterable, deep-search)
get.description: Newest-first keyset page of captured conversations. Filters: origin, project, repo, trace, parent. q is a full-text (FTS5) search across ALL message text/tool calls — returns conversations with a matching message. Reads are always allowed.

get.summary: Distinct conversation origins + projects (filter menus)
Deep search across all conversations (alias of list with q)
get.description: Same as GET /api/conversations with a q; a friendlier path for a full-text search. Filters compose with q.

get.summary: Get one conversation's metadata
Get a conversation's messages (in order); ?q= searches within it
get.description: Returns the conversation's messages ordered by seq. With ?q=, returns only messages matching the in-conversation full-text search.

get.summary: Get the causal chain (forest) a conversation belongs to
get.description: Walks parent_conversation_id to the root, then collects all descendants — every conversation spawned in the same chain (e.g. a global chat, the project it created via the API, and that project's conversations). Ordered by creation. Use with GET /api/logs/trace/{traceId} to render the shared trace waterfall.

post.summary: Analyze a captured conversation with AI (recursive, captured)
post.description: Spawns a fresh Claude to analyze the given conversation's transcript and returns its job id (watch it in the Work tab). The analysis runs as a log-analysis worker whose OWN conversation is captured, with parent_conversation_id = the analyzed conversation — so it joins the causal chain. Mutating (spawns host Claude): subject to the API-writes gate.

get.summary: List a PR's local links (Corral relationships, not GitHub)
get.description: Returns the PRs this one is linked to in Corral's DB (with the target PR's number/title). Local only — nothing on GitHub.

post.summary: Link this PR to another (local Corral relationship)
post.description: Creates a local link prId → linkedPrId. relationship is tests|tested_by|related|depends_on (default related); note is free text. linkedPrId is a Corral internal PR id (see the list/suggest output). Mutating: subject to the API-writes gate.

get.summary: Suggest PRs to link (ranked by changed-file overlap)
Detect stacked PRs from git ancestry (local mirror, not GitHub)
get.description: Reports which other open PRs this one is stacked ON (their head commit is an ancestor of this PR's head — this branch contains their commits) and which are stacked on IT. Derived from the repo's local bare mirror via `git merge-base --is-ancestor` — works whether or not they're marked stacked on GitHub. relation is 'direct' (branched off the other's tip: base==head) or 'transitive' (further back in history).

get.summary: List open PRs across all repos (the inbox)
get.description: Open PRs aggregated across every GitHub repo in the Repos list, live via gh. Each carries its repo id + GitHub NUMBER (not a Corral internal id — these aren't cached yet). To act on one, first POST /api/repos/{id}/prs/fetch with its number to cache it and get its internal id.

get.summary: List a repo's cached PRs (with internal ids)
get.description: PRs Corral has fetched/reviewed for this repo, each with its INTERNAL id (the key used by /api/prs/{id}/notes|merge|links|stack|…). A PR appears here once fetched (see prs/fetch).

id.description: Corral internal id — the key for /api/prs/{id}/* actions

get.summary: List a repo's live open PRs from GitHub
get.description: The repo's currently-open PRs via gh (by GitHub number). Fetch one to get an internal id to act on.

post.summary: Cache a PR from GitHub → get its internal id
post.description: Fetches a PR's metadata + diff via gh and stores it, returning the PR incl. its Corral internal id. This is the bridge from a GitHub number (inbox/open) to an id you can act on. Mutating (writes the cache + gh): subject to the API-writes gate.

id.description: Corral internal id — the key for /api/prs/{id}/* actions

400.description: number required / not a GitHub remote

spec.description: Per-kind config as a JSON string.

dependsOn.description: Reserved for DAG execution; unused while linear.

context.description: Run context as a JSON string.

steps.description: Per-step results as a JSON string.

activity.description: working = a completion is actively streaming; waiting = idle at the prompt; off = container down.

anthropic_hits.description: recent completion hits in the activity window (for display).

peek.description: last non-empty terminal line, for a pane preview.

statusText.description: raw human status from the CLI

catchUp.description: fire once on wake when overdue (default true)

repo.description: repo id to scope to; omit for global

name.description: filesystem-safe slug (becomes a skill dir name)
